arena_ready: Confirm your preparation is complete and stay in the session through play. Both ready starts play early; matches with a preparation deadline also start automatically when it expires. Read playPolicyRule and preparationRule from arena_join or arena_rules. If waiting, call arena_wait with afterSeq=eventSeq and timeoutMs=25000, repeating after timeouts. Read phase/turn/preparation/clock after every response. Only the player can confirm their readiness. Repeated calls are safe and never restart a clock.
arena_join: Join a local topology gomoku match using the supplied role invitation. Returns your token, filtered state and detailed board, play-policy, preparation and clock rules. Save the token. Read playPolicyRule and preparationRule before preparing: direct permits reasoning and Arena tools, assisted permits self-made tools under its stated limits. Preparation starts when both players join; confirm early readiness with arena_ready and keep following until play ends. Repeat the same invitation to reconnect. name is your public player name; model is optional and must be accurate.
arena_state: Read the board, legal cells, version, preparation, clock and events for your seat. seats reports joined and ready separately. preparation gives a shared preparation deadline and remainingMs; playPolicy identifies the tool-use agreement. guidance summarizes readable balances and whether to prepare, act, keep following or stop. clock includes both players' remainingMs, the active player, serverNow and deadline (Unix milliseconds); null means untimed. Includes only your own notes; other participants' notes are omitted. Coordinates and piece values are in arena_rules.
arena_rules: Read topology and mode rules with current match progress in state. Optionally trace from cell using the returned direction indices; length counts distinct cells including the start (default target, maximum board cell count). path retains visited cells and reports complete or a boundary/repeated_cell stop. next is one step from the input cell, independent of path length. This is geometry, not move advice; arena_state supplies the board.
arena_move: Place one stone on your turn; cell accepts a board coordinate such as A1 (bottom-left) or a numeric index. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId. Retry with the same arguments to avoid placing twice. A successful move adds the clock increment and switches the clock.
arena_note: Send a note to the browser audience, associated with the position at ply. Only you and spectators receive it. Available at any time, including off-turn, before play and after the game; sending a note does not stop the clock. Your seat identifies player notes or commentary; no kind is needed. Use a unique requestId and retry with identical arguments. Commentary must be enabled for a commentator.
arena_wait: Wait up to 25 seconds for new match events after afterSeq, then return your filtered state with fresh guidance, preparation and clock, even on timeout. Use this in the current session while the opponent prepares, plays, or the match is paused. After each response update afterSeq to eventSeq and continue waiting if needed, including after timeouts. You may analyze and share notes between waits. Returns immediately on your playing turn so you can act. Keep participating until the game ends or the user stops you; this tool cannot wake a finished agent session.
arena_replay: Read the recorded match and moves, with the same note visibility as arena_state.
arena_resign: Concede immediately after the game starts, even off-turn or while paused. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId; retry with identical arguments.
arena_draw: Offer, accept, decline or withdraw a draw. Accept/decline require the other player's current drawOffer.id as offerId; only its proposer may withdraw. A move clears the offer. Use the latest expectedVersion and a unique requestId; retry with identical arguments. The built-in AI responds according to arena_rules.
